subject: Stan indexing on pp 74-75 of the reference

messages.author: 661793ebd1fd89cc
messages.subject: Stan indexing on pp 74-75 of the reference
parts:
I'm having problems using indexing in a hierarchical regression model.  On pp 74-75 of the reference, I see the lines

int<lower=1,upper=J> jj[N];
matrix[N, K] x;
vector[K] beta[J];

y ~ normal( rows_dot_product(beta[jj] , x),sigma);


When I try something similar, I get the following error:

No matches for:

rows_dot_product(vector[], matrix)

So it looks like rows_dot_product doesn't work with an array of vectors.  How do I handle this?  Can I convert beta[jj] to an NxK matrix somehow?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Stan indexing on pp 74-75 of the reference
parts:
Thanks for pointing out the error in our manual. It'll
be fixed for the next release:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/2051#issuecomment-248715502

to summarize, you need to redeclare beta as a matrix:


parameters {
matrix[J, K] beta;

and then use the sampling statement:

y ~ normal(rows_dot_product(x, beta[jj]), sigma);

beta[jj] will be an N x K matrix, and x is an N x K matrix
and the rows-dot-product operation means you take each
of the N rows and dot-product their K-vectors to get a scalar,
so the result is an N-vector.

- Bob
